title: Scheduled tasks
intro: Run a script, fetch a URL or run a backup plan on a schedule. Each task is a systemd timer; its runs and output are kept by the system journal.
statusUnavailable: The next and last runs are not available right now.

empty.title: No scheduled tasks
empty.text: Create a task to run a script, fetch a URL or run a backup plan on a schedule.

task.deleteText: The task and its timer are removed. Its past output stays in the system journal.
task.rootNote: This task runs as root. Root tasks need your password, and they only run while root terminals are allowed: switching root terminals off stops them.
task.rootOff: Root terminals are switched off right now, so this task will not run.
task.scriptHint: Up to {size}. "#!/bin/sh" is added when the script has no first line starting with "#!".
task.urlHint: The server requests this address at each run; an answer other than 2xx counts as a failure.
task.noPlans: There is no backup plan yet. Create one on the Backups page.

schedule.customHint: A systemd OnCalendar expression, for example "Mon..Fri *-*-* 09:00:00" or "*-*-01,15 04:30:00".
schedule.shortMonths: Months without this day are skipped.

runs.title: Runs of {name}
runs.intro: The newest runs with their output, as the system journal keeps them.
runs.empty: The task has not run yet.
runs.pick: Pick a run to see its output.
runs.truncated: Only the end of the output is shown.
